title: Article: What Are the Different Ways a Person Can Lose Their Agni Tattva?

segments.text: Why Agni Tattva is very important for a person?
Kaam Vasna (Lust) – Drains vital energy through uncontrolled desires.
Krodh (Anger) – Burns Agni Tattva, leading to loss of mental and physical strength.
Lobh (Greed) – Creates endless cravings, weakening inner fire.
Moh (Attachment) – Clouds judgment and drains spiritual energy.
Mad & Matsar (Ego & Jealousy) – Disrupts inner balance and depletes Agni.
How does negativity cause a person to lose their Agni Tattva in relation to Kaam Vasna (lustful desires)?

Negativity naturally pulls a person toward activities that fuel their desires, leading him to seek unrealistic experiences through certain content. Over time, his mind gets conditioned to expect the same intensity in real life.

However, when he try to fulfill these desires physically, he struggles because his Agni Tattva (inner fire) has already been drained. Without this vital energy, his stamina, confidence, and strength weaken, making real-world experiences unfulfilling.

On the other hand, when two people connect without negativity, their auras interact, creating a natural energy exchange that increases their Agni Tattva, boosting their strength and vitality. But in the presence of negativity, this energy flow is blocked, leaving them drained, unsatisfied, and disconnected.
This is why protecting Agni Tattva is so important—it’s the key to true strength, balance, and fulfillment.
How to Preserve Agni Tattva and Protect It from Draining Through Kaam Vasna?

Ashaeiynn never suggests that people should avoid intimacy; rather, it emphasizes the importance of preserving vital energy. According to our scriptures—including the Kamasutra—intimacy strengthens the bond between partners, allowing their auras to connect and energy to flow.

Even divine beings, like Bholenath (Lord Shiva) and Rishi Vishwamitra, engaged in such experiences. However, they mastered the art of retaining their vital force, ensuring their Agni Tattva remained strong. This is what made them exceptionally powerful.
The key is not to suppress intimacy but to channel it wisely, preserving inner energy while deepening emotional and spiritual connections.
Note: Ashaeiynn does not claim deity involvement in such activities; rather, it is evident in temple sculptures and inscriptions, which anyone can verify.
